title: Ookami to Koushinryou II Specials
justification: AniList 6884 (SPECIAL, 2 episode(s) from 2009-10-07) is AniDB 6169's special(s) S1-S2, aired 2009-10-07 to 2009-11-04. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 6169. The parent's row ;1-2;2-3; puts S1-S2 on TVDB 0x2-0x3 (kept by overlay/6169.json).
